features: 【1296p Full HD+ Recording】3MP camera captures all your rides in high-resolution 1296p clarity—perfect for scenic routes, daily commutes, or unexpected incidents.
【124° Wide-Angle Lens】Covers more of your surroundings with a 124-degree field of view—ideal for both open roads and tight city lanes.
【Up to 270 Min Battery Life】Equipped with a 2000mAh battery, the Bike Cam Pro delivers up to 4.5 hours of continuous recording in Smart Saver Mode.
【IP66 Weatherproof Build】Ride worry-free through rain, dust, or splashes. Rugged waterproof design built to endure tough weather conditions.
【Smart AI Emergency Recording】Built-in AI automatically detects mishaps and secures critical footage into a separate event file to prevent overwriting.
【Qubo Pro App Support】Easily manage recordings, playback footage, and adjust settings with the intuitive Android/iOS Qubo Pro App.
【Clip-to-Start Simplicity】No setup hassle—just clip it on and recording starts automatically.
【Superior Low-Light Video】Engineered for low-light riding conditions with enhanced optics to maintain detail during dusk, dawn, or overcast rides.
【Lightweight & Compact】Ergonomic design ensures minimal bulk while offering maximum durability and stability during long rides.
【Expandable Storage Support】Supports SD card storage to save extended rides and event footage (card not included).
